description: Ownership, game licensing, engine licensing and the plan for publishing this documentation.

description: Proposed terms for pre-release builds, testers, feedback and sharing. No prototype programme is operating.

label: Commercial release
description: Proposed end-user, distribution, update and warranty terms for a future release. Nothing is for sale.

description: Proposed privacy, data-retention and save-data terms. The game currently has no save system, accounts, network code or telemetry.

label: Third-party software
description: The dependency inventory and compliance rules for software used by the game and engine.

label: Assets and attribution
description: Asset licensing, the current asset register, and sourcing and attribution rules.

label: Modding and community content
description: Proposed modding, distribution, SDK and community-content rules for features that do not exist yet.

label: Contributions and engine rights
description: The current position on external contributions, a proposed CLA, future guidelines and engine relicensing rights.

label: Distribution and compliance
description: Proposed packaging, redistribution and release checks. None has been exercised for a distributed build.

label: Future and proposed terms
description: Draft terms for accounts, launchers, online services, community processes, copyright and IP enforcement. None is active.

label: Engineering reference
description: Internal architecture, development and Git conventions from the game repository. Reference material, not a policy.
